title: Signless Laplacian extremal conjecture for forbidding $K_{s,t}^+$
statement: Let $2le sle t$ be positive integers. For $n$-vertex graphs, let $K_{s,t}^+$ denote the graph obtained from $K_{s,t}$ by adding an edge within the part of size $s$, let $\mathcal{L}_{n,s,t}$ be the family of joins of $K_{s-1}$ with a nearly $(t-1)$-regular triangle-free graph of order $n-s+1$, and let $\mathcal{Y}_{n,t}$ be the family of joins of $I_{t-1}$ with a nearly $(t-1)$-regular triangle-free graph of order $n-t+1$. **Signless Laplacian extremal conjecture.** If $2\le s\le t$ and $n\ge s+t$, then every $n$-vertex $K_{s,t}^+$-free graph with maximal signless Laplacian spectral radius belongs to either $\mathcal{L}_{n,s,t}$ or $\mathcal{Y}_{n,t}$. The conjecture proposes the structure of the spectral extremal graphs in a setting where the ordinary extremal graph is uniquely the Turán graph; the relevant regular graphs may need to be chosen nearly regular when exact regularity is unavailable.
source_name: Jian Zheng, Yongtao Li and Honghai Li, “The signless Laplacian spectral Turán problems for color-critical graphs”, arXiv:2504.07852 (2025).
